correctness.rationale: Exact closed-neighborhood first-vertex recursion yields the witness fractions from six elementary conditional distributions. Separately, a standard-library program constructs all 1, 1, 3, 16, 125, 1296 labeled trees at orders 1 through 6 by Prüfer codes and exhausts all permutations (up to 720 each). It checks the exact no-gap unimodality criterion and confirms precisely 360 exceptions, all S(1,1,3), with order-counts (190,160,370). No inference is drawn for larger trees.

value.rationale: The graph-size cutoff is natural and sharp, and all shapes at that first size are classified. The gap-free requirement excludes trivial star support gaps, revealing a true interior probability valley in a simple connected acyclic graph. This is a structural boundary between expectation-only information and distributional shape, not a random numerical slice or a minor parameter increment.
